passages.source_title: Sampling Against the Head: Popularity-Debiased Negatives for Recommendation
passages.text: On both datasets we studied, popularity-debiased negative sampling improved Recall@20 on long-tail items (the 80% least popular items) by 21% relative to uniform negative sampling. Overall Recall@20 changed by less than 1% on both datasets.

decision.rationale: The 18.1% relative gain (0.085 vs 0.072) is confirmed (actual 18.06%). P1 states debiased sampling improved long-tail Recall@20 by 21% on both datasets studied, consistent with "roughly 20%". The claim's scope caveat (different datasets) is accurate.
